    Representation-finiteness of the opposite algebra #

    The k-dual D = Hom_k(-, k) sends finite-dimensional left B-modules to right B-modules, reverses endomorphism rings and is involutive up to the evaluation isomorphism. Hence a finite-dimensional algebra is representation-finite if and only if its opposite is (isRepresentationFinite_op). This is used for the dual halves of the local arguments of Part III ("the dual assertion holds", "passing to the opposite algebra").
